Name: Prawnguin's Bear Family Portraits
Author: Prawnguin
Description:
[b]Current version has:[/b]
[list]
[*]Default portraits for each Bear Family member.
[*]2 variations for Sig's (blue or black hair).
[*]4 variations for Gunnar's (no freckles and no glasses, no freckles with glasses, freckled without glasses, and freckled with glasses).
[*]A config file to change the portrait variations.
[*][i]The winter, Flower Dance, and Spirit's Eve outfits are not yet implemented.[/i]
[/list]
[b]Future plans:[/b]
[list]
[*]Winter Outfits, Flower Dance, and Spirit's Eve variations.
[*]Portraits for the "Lite" config.
[*]Edits to the MEEP images.
[/list]
-----

[b]How to Install:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Ensure you have all the required mods.
[*]Extract the .zip file into your "Stardew Valley\Mods" folder, separate from the main Bear Family mod.
[*]In the main Bear Family mod, edit the configuration for "SeasonalOutfits", and set it to "vanilla". With the current version of this mod, the portraits will not show up without this setting or will be inconsistent.
[/list]
-----

Thank you Abagaianye for helping me figure out the code for this!

All of the wonderful characters and story belong to the creator of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16197]Bear Family[/url]: [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/maddogofblank/mods]maddogofblank[/url]. Thank you so much for an amazing mod! ^^

Downloads.Description: Anime-style portraits for the Bear Family (Content Patcher). Currently only for the vanilla outfits configuration in the main mod. See changelogs for the updates.
